speaker: richard_burbage
text: Did he like it? The little man?

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I am only cold. I have been the king since the second of October. The king is off me. That is the news.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then be cold. We go by Fleet Street, and Ludgate, and Cheapside. We part at the mouth of the close. Thou art not required to whistle.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I will when I am north of you. Not at a shut gate. A jig here would be a confession.
